svg.metadata: Author: Angelis Pseftis. Procedural dimensionless construction reference.
svg.text: DIMENSIONLESS • CANDIDATE TOPOLOGY • NOT A PRODUCTION MODEL
Two complete spans in perpendicular planes.
Second crown is 0.18 reference units higher; positive crossing clearance.
These are geometric curves, not final glass forms; end supports and shader shadow alternatives need detailed design.
Author: Angelis Pseftis • All views project the same vertices; view framing scales independently.
